SotM taking all your time, Spiff?

I run a collection of role-playing games, most in what we affectionately refer to as AD&D 2.7 (in a campaign world I’ve been running since 1984) and another in Pathfinder.

Been having a strange urge to run Traveller, lately, though. I’m also planning a sequel to a game I ran a couple years ago using a customization of the Everway rules (diceless role-playing).

I also volunteer for some local organizations. For example, I screen films for and work at the Heartland film festival here in Indianapolis and I do some things for the Coalition for Homelessness Intervention and Prevention of Greater Indianapolis (CHIP) - when time allows.

And, of course, helping out with Sentinels where I can. ;D

Just wish I had more time to do all these things… :-\

Like TamarBatAvraham, I am also in the SCA (http://www.sca.org) and I do a lot of administrative type stuff with that organization (I’m the recruitment and retention officer for the multi-state region and maintain the membership database). Being in the SCA leads to a lot of camping, crafting, and doing random awesome things like writing poems in medieval German.

I also do some sewing, mostly medieval clothing for the SCA, though I am making an awesome quilted mobile of the solar system for the parasite I’m rocking right now. I’m currently playing in a pathfinder game too. Most of my time right now though has been going to the SCA and getting my life ready for a baby.

posts.name: Nilus
posts.cooked:
I use to be a video game/PC gamer but when I got to the point in career where I spend 50 to 60 hours a week looking at a computer screen I decided to give them up mostly. Also use to role play a lot when I was younger but not so much in the last few years.

My two current hobbies/jobs are

  1. Being a Dad to a awesome 4 year old son. He is not quite old enough for SOTM yet but this summer we plan to start expanding his Board game collection to include some more interesting game(Thinking of trying “That’s my Fish”)

  2. I am a Malifaux Henchman and playtester. Malifaux is a skirmish level steampunk, horror, minature game with some really cool unique rules. And a Henchman is what they call there demo team guys(Like a Press Ganger for Privateer Press, or an Outrider for Games workshop). I have been doing that since the game was released in 2009. Along with demoing the game I also run events. I am the lead person in charge of all the Malifaux events at Adepticon and I have recently been asked and accepted the job to run all the Malifaux tournament events at Gencon this year.
